required_raw_sources: Native ego identity, transform and bounding box per frame
Native grade profile and crest geometry
Native ray-cast sightline clear-distance bracket and censor status per frame
Native other vehicle identity, route direction and transform
four original synchronized source camera streams
legal_boundaries: No numeric distance defines a statutory hazard.
Observed opposite-direction vehicle is useful evidence but the law says one might approach.
The one-way exception must be sourced from road authority and geometry, not inferred from one observed route.
Fixture values cannot establish actual driver view, Native motion, legal result, or physical completion.
